```Gateways/Setak.IMS.Blazor.UI/Pages/Equipment/Editor.razor
@{

@using Blazorise.DataGrid
@using Setak.IMS.Blazor.UI.Components.Selectors
@using Setak.IMS.Classes.DTOs.Equ
@using Setak.IMS.Classes.DTOs.Pub
@using Setak.IMS.Classes.DTOs.Reg

<PageLoading LoadContent="(isInitialized && model != null)" @ref="loadingRef">
    <Form>
        <Validations MissingFieldsErrorMessage="خطای اعتبارسنجی" Mode="ValidationMode.Auto" ValidateOnLoad="false" Model="model" @ref="validationsRef">
            @* Row 1 *@
            @* مشخصات تجهیز *@
            <Row>
                <Column ColumnSize="ColumnSize.IsFull">
                    <Paragraph Class="page-section-title">:: @WordsResource.EquipmentGroup</Paragraph>
                </Column>

                @* Column 1 *@
                <Column ColumnSize="ColumnSize.Is6.OnDesktop.Is6.OnTablet.IsFull.OnMobile">
<|editable_region_start|>
                    @* EmploymentType *@
                    <Field>
                        @{
                            string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<EquipmentDto>(x => x.EquipmentGroupId);
                            string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<EquipmentDto>(x => x.EquipmentGroupId) ?? elementId;
                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>

                        <EquipmentGroupSelector AuthorizePolicy="@AuthorizePolicy" @ref="_EquipmentGroupSelector"
                                                OnSelectItem<|user_cursor_is_here|>="OnSelectEquipmentGroupAsync"
                                                SelectionMode="DataGridSelectionMode.Single"
                                                ReadOnly="true"
                                                ShowCheckbox="false"
                        />

                        <Field>
                            <Addons>
                                <Addon AddonType="AddonType.Body">
<|editable_region_end|>

                                    <TextEdit ReadOnly="true" Text="@model.EquipmentGroupName"/>
                                </Addon>

                                <Addon AddonType="AddonType.End">
                                    <Button Color="Color.Primary" Clicked="OpenEquipmentGroupSelector">
                                        <Icon Name="IconName.Search"/>
                                    </Button>
                                </Addon>
                            </Addons>
                        </Field>

                    </Field>

                    @* PersianName *@
                    <Field>
                        @{
                            string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<EquipmentDto>(x => x.DisplayName);
                            string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<EquipmentDto>(x => x.DisplayName) ?? elementId;
                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
                        <TextEdit ReadOnly="true" ElementId="@elementId" Text="@model.DisplayName"/>
                    </Field>
```
